verdict.rationale: The open-source repo documents six model sizes, four with English-only variants, that offer speed and accuracy tradeoffs, and models such as `turbo` (CLI) and `gpt-transcribe` (API) can be selected explicitly. A hands-on report confirms that larger, more accurate models are much slower without a GPU. However, the evidence shows no published accuracy figures, latency numbers or per-model cost comparison. missing for 10: published per-model accuracy metrics (e.g., WER), documented latency figures, published cost/pricing tradeoffs between models, and a comparison of the API transcription models.
